direction: Low and unhurried, telling a friend something they half-know. 'Fix a name here, pay a fine there' gets a small dry lift; the last clause lands flat and final.
narration: Your government record already exists — split across portals that never talk. Fix a name here, pay a fine there; nothing remembers what you did last week.
captions: Your government record already exists —
split across portals that never talk.
Fix a name here, pay a fine there;
nothing remembers what you did last week.

direction: The product sentence. Say 'one living record' with quiet certainty, then the three clauses evenly, like three fingers.
narration: Citizen is one living record. It knows what changed, what applies to you, and what to do next.
captions: Citizen is one living record.
It knows what changed, what applies to you,
and what to do next.

direction: Steady demo pace. Three findings as facts, not alarms; the mother is warmer than the other two.
narration: Arjun opens Home. It already knows: his PAN doesn't match Aadhaar, a challan is due, and his mother may need help with her property papers.
captions: Arjun opens Home. It already knows:
his PAN doesn't match Aadhaar,
a challan is due,
and his mother may need help with her property papers.

direction: Walk the viewer through it, step by step, brisk and clear. 'in one tap' satisfied. Then 'Money, Documents and History' evenly spaced; 'one write, no copies' relaxed.
narration: He types 'pay my challan'. Citizen finds the fine on his record, matches it to his scooter, and he pays in one tap. Money, Documents and History update together — one write, no copies.
captions: He types “pay my challan”.
Citizen finds the fine on his record, matches it to his scooter,
and he pays in one tap.
Money, Documents and History update together —
one write, no copies.

direction: Warm; this is two people. 'Say Arjun and Priya…' like setting up a story. Gentle emphasis on 'exactly'. 'Both records update' with a small smile.
narration: Say Arjun and Priya want to register their marriage. He invites her from the app; from her own profile, Priya sees exactly what she is sharing, and consents. Both records update.
captions: Say Arjun and Priya want to register their marriage.
He invites her from the app;
from her own profile, Priya sees exactly what she is sharing,
and consents. Both records update.

direction: Matter-of-fact contrast. Acknowledge the submitted request, then land clearly on the unchanged name.
narration: The request was sent. But Arjun's PAN still has the wrong name.
captions: The request was sent.
But Arjun's PAN still has the wrong name.

direction: One continuous action. Put the emphasis on original reference and history, not on the word grievance.
narration: He marks it unresolved. Citizen carries the original reference and history into a grievance, without asking him to start again.
captions: He marks it unresolved.
Citizen carries the original reference and history
into a grievance, without asking him to start again.

direction: A short, calm interruption, not a dramatic failure. Leave a beat after fails; make recovery feel ordinary.
narration: The send fails. Nothing was submitted. His draft stays. Reload, retry, and just one follow-up joins the original matter.
captions: The send fails. Nothing was submitted.
His draft stays.
Reload, retry, and just one follow-up
joins the original matter.

direction: Give the brief room to be read. Warm but precise. The final contrast is the point of the film.
narration: His case brief keeps the evidence, actions and reference numbers together. Ready to print or save. The problem may remain unresolved. His record does not start over.
captions: His case brief keeps the evidence, actions
and reference numbers together.
Ready to print or save.
The problem may remain unresolved.
His record does not start over.

direction: Plain and kind. 'nothing else' firm. Slow slightly on 'When the permission is revoked, the link ends' and let 'so the history stays' sit — it is the point of the film.
narration: Sunita never fills a form. Arjun asks for access, she approves, and he sees the shared records, not her whole profile. When permission is revoked, the link ends, but the history stays.
captions: Sunita never fills a form.
Arjun asks for access, she approves,
and he sees the shared records, not her whole profile.
When permission is revoked, the link ends,
but the history stays.

direction: Quiet and conclusive. 'the whole story you just watched' with a touch of warmth, as if closing a file. Keep the pace brisk, around 160 words per minute; do not stretch to fill time.
narration: Every change names who made it. One log holds the whole story you just watched.
captions: Every change names who made it.
One log holds the whole story you just watched.

direction: Deliver this entire 23-word close briskly within eight seconds, around 175 words per minute. No long pauses between sentences, no drawn-out words. Say UPI as U P I. The public services question has rising curiosity; One connected record ends with firm downward conviction. Speak only the transcript.
narration: India built UPI for payments. Why not do the same for public services? One country. A billion lives. One connected record.
captions: India built UPI for payments.
Why not do the same for public services?
One country. A billion lives.
One connected record.
